segments.name: Development and Manufacturing of Electric Aircraft
segments.description: It designs, manufactures and sells electric aircraft, propulsion systems, batteries and charging equipment for cargo, medical, defense, passenger and aftermarket customers.
segments.evidence: The Company has one operating and reportable segment - Development and Manufacturing of Electric Aircraft.

revenueModel.text: Military and commercial operators, aftermarket operators, other eVTOL manufacturers and state governments pay for aircraft, replacement batteries, propulsion systems and chargers.
revenueModel.evidence: Our business model contemplates four key revenue streams: (1) selling aircraft to military and commercial customers such as UPS, Air New Zealand and United Therapeutics; (2) selling replacement batteries to operators in the aftermarket; (3) selling propulsion systems as a merchant supplier to other eVTOL manufacturers such as Embraer-backed EVE Air Mobility ("EVE"), Textron eAviation and defense technologies; and (4) selling GSE, primarily chargers, to state governments, operators, Fixed Base Op
